companies.name: PostHog
companies.productSummary: B2B open-source product analytics software platform that serves as a 'product's context layer.' Ingests and stores analytics, errors, replays, and business data so teams and AI agents can query and act on it. Features include product analytics, session replay, error tracking, feature flags, experiments, surveys, data warehouse (120+ sources/destinations), CDP, workflows, logs, and AI observability. Usage-based pricing with generous free tiers (98% of customers use for free). Offers self-hosted and cloud options with 500,000+ teams.
companies.fitReason: PostHog is a B2B open-source product analytics software platform and developer tools company, directly matching the ideal customer criteria. They position themselves explicitly as developer tools, providing an all-in-one product OS with SDKs for JavaScript, Python, React Native, Android, iOS, and more. They are not an agency or consulting business. Their open-source nature is confirmed by their public GitHub repository (github.com/posthog/posthog) with 66k+ commits and 587+ contributors.
companies.painHypothesis: Hypothesis: B2B companies building digital products struggle with fragmented analytics and product data that cannot be easily queried or integrated with their development workflows, leading to context-switching and delayed insights. PostHog solves this by unifying analytics, error tracking, session replays, feature flags, and warehouse data into a single queryable platform with developer-first tooling and AI agent integration.

sources.excerpt: PostHog ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it. Join 500,000+ teams already shipping with PostHog.

contactCoverageGaps: No product marketing team page or product marketing personnel were found in publicly accessible areas of the PostHog website. No Product Marketing Manager or similar role could be identified.

The Customer Success NA-West and NA-North team pages returned empty or cookie-banner-only content, so current NA Customer Success team members could not be verified from public pages (though an open requisition for TCSM EMEA was found).

Charles Cook is listed as 'Generic Exec Person' overseeing marketing, brand & demand gen, and was previously first ops person scaling sales & support orgs - partial CS-adjacent responsibility but title does not match target roles.
No Product Marketing personnel were found despite checking the marketing team handbook page (https://posthog.com/handbook/marketing) and all available team pages.
The task explicitly says not to infer names from open vacancies (the TCSM EMEA open job was found but should not be included as it's a vacancy, not a current hire).
